claims.claim: These 2 books are perfect combo for intentional people, who don't just want to be at the top but...
claims.evidence: Witness only reports readable book covers; no evidence about the 'combo' or intended audience.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints.
claims.evidence: Photos show only front covers; no ISBN/edition page, copyright page, or inside pages to confirm originality.
Inside pages are not shown; cover-only view cannot confirm absence of writing/highlights.

risks.risk: Inside condition may be poor (writing, highlights, torn/missing pages) even if covers look clean.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the first 5–10 pages and the page edges (showing no writing/highlights and no missing/loose pages).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with unknown inside condition (worst case: may have writing/highlights or minor page issues).

risks.risk: Could be photocopies/reprints or wrong editions despite correct-looking covers.
risks.proof: A photo of the copyright/ISBN page for each book (showing publisher, edition/year, and ISBN).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially non-original/unknown edition until ISBN/copyright pages confirm.

risks.risk: Physical format/quality unknown (hardback vs paperback; dust jacket presence; binding quality).
risks.proof: A side-spine photo and a photo of the back cover for each book (showing format and binding).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for unknown format (worst case: paperback with possible wear).

risks.risk: Cover wear not fully visible (creases, fading, water damage) beyond what the front cover shows.
risks.proof: Photos of the covers from the side and the bottom edges/corners for each book.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible minor cover wear not captured in the front-only view.

proof_requests: For each book: photo of the copyright/ISBN page (publisher, edition/year, ISBN).
For each book: photo of the inside pages (first pages and a random middle page) showing no writing/highlights and page integrity.
For each book: side-spine photo and back cover photo to confirm hardback vs paperback and binding condition.
For each book: close-up of corners/edges (top/bottom) to check for creases, water damage, or fading.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the two specific book titles/authors from readable front covers, so the item can be priced. However, originality and inside-page condition are not verifiable from the provided photos, so it should be priced at the worst-case used condition until the requested proof is provided.
